original_description: Diagnose drift across the six cache layers of the Claude Code / Claude Desktop plugin system using the `cpd` CLI (`claude-plugin-doctor`). Use when a Claude plugin is still loading an old version after `claude plugin marketplace update` or `claude plugin update`, when those report `already at latest version` but it isn't, when a plugin author bumped `plugin.json#version` but Desktop's `Update available` badge stays silent, when an installed plugin's files are missing on disk, or when troubleshooting upstream Anthropic plugin-cache bugs (issues #46081, #13799, #19197, #15642, #35691, #48675). Runs `cpd --json` to pinpoint which cache layer is stale (marketplace clone, install snapshot, Cowork mirror, RPM copy, skills-plugin) and proposes the minimum-impact fix — refresh, version bump, `--force-fetch` bypass for the silent-cooldown bug, or registration cleanup — for the user to confirm before any destructive operation.
best_description: Use for diagnosing and fixing Claude Code / Claude Desktop plugin staleness, stuck updates, and cache drift. Triggers when a plugin keeps loading an old version, when `claude plugin update` or `claude plugin marketplace update` says "already at latest" but isn't, when a `plugin.json` version bump doesn't show up in Desktop's "Update available" badge, when an installed plugin's files are missing on disk, when a manually-deleted plugin breaks Desktop, when skills/commands won't refresh after marketplace pushes, or when the user mentions `cpd`, `claude-plugin-doctor`, or drift kinds like `marketplace-update-broken`, `bump-needed`, `badge-only-needed`, `registration-drift`, `skills-plugin-stuck`. Runs the `cpd` CLI to pinpoint which of six cache layers is stale and recommends the safest fix, confirming before any destructive action.
final_description: Use when a Claude Code or Claude Desktop plugin won't update — loading old/stale code, stuck on a previous version, missing files on disk, or broken after manual deletion. Triggers on symptoms like `claude plugin update` or `claude plugin marketplace update` reporting "already at latest" when it isn't, a `plugin.json` version bump not appearing in Desktop's update badge, skills/commands not refreshing after a marketplace push, an installed plugin's directory empty under `~/.claude/plugins/cache/`, or Desktop crashing after a plugin was deleted by hand. Also triggers on `cpd`, `claude-plugin-doctor`, or drift terms (`marketplace-update-broken`, `bump-needed`, `badge-only-needed`, `registration-drift`, `skills-plugin-stuck`). Runs the `cpd` CLI to identify which of six plugin cache layers is stale and recommends the safest fix, confirming before destructive actions.
